Formulation difference: upstream s4lagsfem builds SFEM_NODVAR_k = sum(V_e)/sum(mass_e) per node through the tetra_fsky table and an SPMD halo, which s4voln_m/s4forc3 consume as an effective ELEMENT volume weighting UNSMOOTHED CST gradients; the port instead normalises node-domain shape-function gradients (V_k = sum V_e/4, grad~N_k = sum (V_e/4) grad N^e_k / V_k) and applies those smoothed gradients directly to L, deps and f_int. Same smoothing quantity, different formulation; also no SPMD exchange. Parity NOT measured - no oracle/parity case for Itetra4=3 exists, only the analytic unit tests tests/test_itetra3.py::test_itetra3_sfem_smoothing and tests/test_fe_solids_advanced.py::test_tetra4_sfem_smoothing. Note solid_tetra4.py separately reproduces the upstream effective-volume formulation (see the s4voln_m row).

the main STRAIN_FORMULATION=1 branch is implemented (Jbar_e = 1/4*sum(J_a), AMU = 1/Jbar_e - 1, DIVDE, the DTREP_R trace correction and vol_eff = Jbar_e*V0_e used in place of VOLGS). Absent: the ISMSTR=11 rho/rho0 branch, the ISMSTR>=10 branch calling JACOB_J33 with the log volume-ratio rescaling, and the ISMSTR=2/12 with IDTMIN(1)==3 branch.

the volume comes from solid_tetra4._geometry (same cofactor determinant) with np.add.at scattering V_e to the 4 incident nodes; the 1/4 weight upstream applies later in s4voln_m is applied at scatter time (same product).

the per-node volume scatter is present (init_group writes fsky(:,2)=VOL0 and pre_forces re-accumulates the current element volumes to nodes each cycle). Absent: the SAV small-strain-coordinate + velocity driven equivalent volume, the ISMSTR sub-domains, the TT==ZERO skip and the off gating.

node-to-element incidence accumulation exists (model.nodal_vol_0/nodal_vol_t plus sfem_v0_nodes/sfem_v_nodes). Absent: the sfem_ structure itself (node_list, node_iad, tetra4_iad, tetra10_iad, the tetra_fsky table with its row layout), the Lagrangian/ALE two-structure split and the ISROT/ICPRE/ISMSTR/MTN eligibility scan; the port re-derives adjacency every cycle.
no SFEM halo send/recv index construction; pyradioss/spmd/domdec.py instead flags tetras_sfem as unsupported ('SFEM tetra: nodal smoothing buffer').
velocity-gradient strain rates dxx..dzz via sum_i p_i.v_i, the same contraction as L=einsum('nib,ngic->ngbc').

only the ISMSTR==11 spin branch is implemented (wxy = (L_xy-L_yx)/2*dt, engineering d4/d5/d6). Absent: the vol=voldp clamp with off gating, the three non-11 objective-rotation correction branches and the /ANIM/ELEM/VORT output.
same contraction as s6zdefc3 with the spin forced to zero, as in the Fortran's 'T' variant.

the Fortran builds J from the edge combinations with a scalar-triple-product determinant and a closed-form cofactor inverse; the port builds the same constant linear-wedge J by einsum and takes det/inverse by cofactor expansion, and sum_g(0.5*detJ) equals the Fortran's one_over_8*triple. The Fortran's runtime negative-volume re-orientation (restore from sav, offg=2) is absent; the port flips the winding once at starter time.
same body as s6zderi3 minus the sav-recovery branch; the same port symbol serves both.
converts the stored cofactor inverse into the 18 shape-function gradients; the port forms dndx = dN/dxi . Jinv with the identical cofactor inverse.
f_ib = -sum_c S_bc * gradN_ic * w * detJ, identical to the port's einsum.

the whole explicit cycle (gather, kinematics, constitutive update, failure, bulk viscosity, internal forces + scatter, dt_crit). The driver's corotational/orthotropic/non-local branches (s6zrcoor3, sztorth3/storth3/szordef3, s6fint_reg) are absent.

same quantity - the wedge HEPH hourglass force - by a different formulation: the Fortran builds gamma by Belytschko-Bindeman orthogonalisation over the full mode set, scales the stiffness by the element-specific szetfac visco-elastic factor and adds mdama24 material damping (both gated on iplast/iet); the port instead uses hard-coded out-of-phase hourglass vectors with its own damping. Parity has NOT been measured: no wedge case exists in tools/validation_data or VALIDATION.md, only the synthetic unit tests test_fe_solids_advanced.py::test_penta6_heph_stabilization and test_fe_engine_integration.py::test_engine_penta6_heph_isolid24.
det plus the 3x3 inverse Jacobian from the nodal coordinates by the same one_over_8 triple product and cofactor inverse; the port returns det*w as vol_g and consumes Jinv directly.
the trilinear H_i = 1/8*(1+xi_i r)(1+eta_i s)(1+zeta_i t) is precomputed at the 8 GPs; the PR/PS/PT derivative arrays are _DN_DXI. Same formulation.

basisf is BASIS8 evaluated at the fixed IP coordinates in its DATA G(3,8); the port holds those eight +/-1/sqrt(3) points in _GP_COORDS and pre-evaluates the values/derivatives instead of calling BASISF per IP.

only the internal-energy booking exists (_post returns deint0, stored as the extensive st['eint'] and summed generically by the engine). Absent: per-part PARTSAV(1..6), the FLAG==1 XCG/XM/XXM/IXX..IZX block, GRELEM_SAV (IGRE) and SENSOR_ENERGY_BILAN.
xe = x[conn], ve = v[conn] performs the same gather; dead elements (off<=0) have deps/trD zeroed in _pre, the vectorised equivalent of upstream zeroing VXLOC/VYLOC/VZLOC.
accumulation of the element force arrays into the global external force A and of STI into nodal STIFN is not ported; forces() scatters internal forces into fint only.
_pre builds L = sum_i ve (x) dN/dx, D = (L+L^T)/2, W = (L-L^T)/2 and the engineering-shear deps - the JCVT==0 branch of S8DEFO3 exactly.

Jacobian, detJ and the cartesian shape-function gradients at the 8 GPs are the same formulation. Absent: the DELTAX output (100*VMIN/sqrt(SMAX), the min-determinant length handed to the material law - the port uses sdlen3's V/max-face-area instead) and the negative-Jacobian ANCMSG(172)/ARRET abort, downgraded to a log.error.
OFF from the ETAG node-activity product is not ported; element death in the port comes from the engine erosion/failure module and solid_hexa8_full only reads st['off'].
fe = -sum_g vol_g * S . dndx after subtracting QVIS from the three normal components, the same combination and sign convention as S8FINT3 (SVIS is not a separate term in the port).

full driver: gather -> _pre (s8deri3+s8defo3+s8rota3) -> the per-GP materials.solid_update loop -> _post (bulk viscosity + s8fint3 + dt) -> scatter_add3 into fint. The JCVT=1 rotating path has no counterpart.
rho = mass/vol is algebraically the same update as S8LAGR3's RHO(I)=RHO0*VOL0/VOLN with a mass-conserving mass. Not implemented: DVOL(I)=VOLN-(RHO0/RHO)*VOL0 and the EINT(I)=EINT(I)*VOL0(I) rescale.
_pre applies the identical component-wise Jaumann update sigma += (W.sigma - sigma.W)*dt with the same sign pattern as the Q1/Q2/Q3 block of S8ROTA3.
rotating-element (JCVT=1) energy balance using the element rotational DOFs; no rotating-solid group exists in pyradioss.

rotating-element frame gather (calls sortho3/srepisot3 and projects X, V and the inertia tensor into the element frame); solid_hexa8z._corotational_frame is the s8zforc3 port of srepisot3/sortho3, a different family.
the centre Jacobian/volume is present as the mean of the 8 GP Jacobians (exact for a trilinear hexa); the DIV0 initial divergence output is absent.

the Fortran updates the PIJ bubble stresses from the B-matrix and nodal velocities (DC1=C1*dt, DG2=2G*dt) and books EINT; the port relaxes 9 pij variables by a hard-coded 0.01*vol*xi*sigma loop with no C1/G/v term and no energy booking. Parity NOT measured (no EAS oracle case exists in the repo).
same output (the EAS element tangent) via 9-mode static condensation with the port's own M(xi), versus upstream's dynamically coupled BIJ/Pij stiffness. Not measured.
derivatives at the fixed 8 GPs are computed; upstream evaluates at the NPT integration points and builds the EAS-coupled arrays through S8BICP11.
the EAS-coupled bubble derivative coupling is replaced by K_ua/K_aa from the port's own M plus condensation. Not measured.
detJ at the GPs plus the negative-volume check in init_group are ported; the SMALLB3/SMALLGEO3 small-strain flag and the DEGENES8 degeneracy detection are absent.
the EAS-condensed derivative coefficients P/PXY are replaced by compatible 8-GP dndx. Not measured.
the same nodal force -int sigma.grad(N), but contracted with compatible GP gradients instead of the condensed coefficients; the SVIS/SIG_A stabilised-stress terms are absent. Not measured.
element-average energy bookkeeping is present; the element-mean stress state SIGM/EINTM is not stored.

the explicit cycle (geometry, rates, Jaumann, constitutive update, viscosity, force scatter, energy, dt) is ported; the EAS-defining stress update (s8edefo*/s8ederi_bij), the s8e_sig_a bubble path, hourglass, thermal, ANIM, failure and MMAIN state are absent.
the 24 coupled B-coefficient arrays are formed inline by einsum from the port's M instead of materialised. Not measured.
the cell Jacobian is built in closed form by einsum over _DN_DXI instead of the SX/SY/SZ decomposition.
dN/dx = _DN_DXI . Jinv at each GP, same formulation.
read in full, this is the HOURGLASS viscous force (NFHOUR/NU), not bulk viscosity; no pyradioss module implements it (the port's qa/qb bulk viscosity is a different routine, mmain/mqviscb).
the 8-GP and total volumes are ported; the single-point/condensed VOLG and the nodal VOLP are not.
inverse-Jacobian entries at the GPs from the same cofactor route.
the Jacobian at the parametric centre, which for a trilinear hexa is exactly the mean of the 8 GP Jacobians.
crimp/imperfection frame construction; the crimp path (Iframe) is not routed in pyradioss
crimp transform kernel (1,123 lines); no reference to it anywhere in pyradioss
projects the 8-node increment UL* onto the local direction cosines R; called only from srcoor3_imp

the Fortran builds BB=C*B from explicit mid-edge sampling (A1A1..C2B3, UM=(1-zeta)/8, UP=(1+zeta)/8) times the INVJ-derived C(6,6); the port post-averages the compatible B rows (shear components 4/5 across the xi/eta Gauss-point pairs, normal component 2 across the 4 in-plane points per zeta-plane). Parity NOT measured: no HA8/Isolid=16 case exists in tools/validation_data or VALIDATION.md; the only checks are tests/test_fe_solids_advanced.py::test_solid_shell_ha8_ans and tests/test_m614_implicit_elements_solids.py, which assert dt_crit>0, force equilibrium, symmetry and shape only.
saves the 21-component SAV geometry vector for OFF=0 elements; crimp path absent

the Fortran contracts the nodal increments through the ANS B and C matrices into natural strain rates DXX..D6 and returns BB=C*B with the ICP=1/2 volumetric branch; the port uses L=v.dndx, D=sym(L), deps=dt*D in global Cartesian, with no ANS projection and no volumetric branch. Parity not measured.

same formulation: the 2x2x2 Gauss Jacobian, a cofactor inverse instead of an explicit 3x3 determinant, the same DN_X/DN_Y/DN_Z and the weighted volume (the port clips detJ at 0 where the Fortran sets OFF=0).

the Fortran assembles F = sum (SIG+SVIS-QVIS) contracted with the ANS B-matrix; the port assembles fe = -sum vol_g * sigma * dndx from the plain compatible gradient, with QVIS present but no SVIS viscous stress. Parity not measured.
crimp nodal force from TRM/COR_NF/COR_FR; crimp path not routed

gather, Jacobian, velocity gradient, Jaumann rotation, material law, bulk viscosity, force assembly, energies and the critical dt are done. Absent: the ANS-projected strain rate and ANS B, the SVIS viscous stress, the srcoor3_imp intrinsic rotation/local frames and every crimp branch.

the material tangent is integrated over 8 GPs and assembled to global DOFs, but the Fortran route is local-frame (HH from PM(21)/PM(32), per-point KL via s8slke3, TRANSK local-to-global, plus the S8SKSIG skew term); the port has no local frame, no TRANSK and no skew term.
skew/non-linear stiffness from COR_NF and the local frames V1..V8; COR_NF appears nowhere in pyradioss. solid_shell_ha8.kgeo is the initial-stress geometric stiffness, a different quantity.

same GP stiffness integration KL += B^T.HV.B, but the Fortran HV is the isotropic HH(1)=LAMDA, HH(2)=GG/2 from PM(21)/PM(32) with the S8SANSB matrix; the port integrates vol_g * B_ans^T * D * B_ans with materials.solid_tangent per law and a pair-averaged B. Parity not measured.
updates the COR_XR reference geometry when INCONV=1; no INCONV/COR_XR state in pyradioss
only the gather (xe = x[conn], ve = v[conn]) is performed; the intrinsic rotation GAMA, the local frames V1..V8 / R11..R33, the TRM transforms and the whole crimp chain are absent.
builds the element local frames V1..V8 and the 24x24 local/global transform TRM for the implicit route; solid_hexa8z._corotational_frame is a different frame (srepiso3/sortho3, a different family)
transforms the accumulated local 24x24 KL to global through TRM; the port builds the HA8 stiffness directly in global Cartesian DOFs and has no TRM

the velocity-gradient Dxx..Dzz plus the ICP==1 assumed-volumetric-dilatation DVCA term are reproduced with the same formulation. Absent: the ICP/=1 B-matrix branch, the ICR/ICS/ICT constant-stress branches, the JCVT/ISCAU non-linear correction and the DSV volume-update bookkeeping.

the centroid Jacobian, determinant, volume and dN/dx are computed by cofactor inversion of the same trilinear derivative set. Absent: the per-node PX..PZY assumed-strain gradients, the ICP/=1 and ICP==11 BXY/BYX/BXZ/BZX/BYZ/BZY matrices, PXC/PYC/PZC and DELTAX/SMAX.

same output (nodal internal forces from sigma and gradN, rotated back by R) but the volumetric-stress treatment differs: the port subtracts only QVIS from the three normal components, whereas upstream's ICP==1 general branch removes a third of the stress trace and scales by JFAC*VOL. The ICP/=1 B-matrix force terms and the SVIS/thermal/plastic-work averages are absent. Parity has NOT been measured: no validation case is tied to s8zfint3 or to this element group.

forces() runs the explicit corotational cycle (frame, kinematics, material law, hourglass, stress rotation, energy, critical dt, force scatter) but only the default path: no degenerate-element handling, no small-strain/ISPIN variants, no thermal, no sensor or element-failure bookkeeping and no per-cycle state save.

MISATTRIBUTION: upstream sz_dt1.F90 is a B-matrix hourglass characteristic length DELTAX1 = 1/sqrt(d) gated on gfac = G/BULK < 1; solid_cohesive.py and solid_connect.py cite it for an eigenvalue dt bound instead, which is a different quantity.

DET and the cartesian shape gradients of the hex-8 by centroid cofactor expansion; the SZDERI3 hourglass PXaHi products, the SCHKJABT3 negative-Jacobian rescue and the SZDERIT3/SZDERITO3 orientation variants have no counterpart.

MISATTRIBUTION: upstream szforc3 is the Isolid=11/12 orthotropic solid continuum driver (srcoor3 -> mmain -> szderi3 -> sordeft3/szordef3 -> szsvm/szsvm_or/szsigpara -> szhour3 -> sfint3 -> srrota3). pyradioss/elements/solid_cohesive.py cites szforc3.F but implements a bilinear traction-separation cohesive element that exists nowhere under engine/source/elements/, and the port has no orthotropic solid kernel at all (/PROP/SOL_ORTH is parsed but its isolid defaults to 14, which routes to the tshells group).

output/anim helper called by dfunc6.F, h3d_solid_scalar_1.F and stat_s_ortho.F: it builds the global-to-orthotropic passage matrix from the element frame (sortho31/scortho31) and the material direction cosines GAMA(1:6). No pyradioss module performs this solid 4th-order frame transform; shell_ortho.py is the SHELL planar in-plane fiber frame (corthdir.F), a different quantity.
